settings.text: Natural care, chosen by people who use it every day. We bring skin care, wellness supplements, superfoods and eco-friendly home products together on one honest shelf.

settings.label: Natural products
settings.text: Each one tested by our team

settings.heading: It started with a simple question
settings.text:
Why is it so hard to find everyday care that is natural, honest and easy to choose? We asked ourselves that in 2019 — and started with a few products we already trusted at home.

Today our shelves hold skin and body care, herbal complexes, sprouted-grain superfoods and eco-friendly cleaning products. The rule has not changed: if we would not use it ourselves, it does not go in the store.

settings.quote: Good care is the one you enjoy every day. Everything else is just a nice label.
settings.author: Olena Kovalenko

settings.heading: Not sure what suits you?
settings.text: Tell us what you are looking for — skin type, a goal, a gift — and we will suggest a few products that fit. Every message is read by a person, and we reply within a day.

settings.question: Where do your products come from?
settings.answer: We work directly with seven makers, most of them family brands we know personally. Every product comes straight from the maker to our warehouse — no resellers in between.

settings.question: How do you choose what to sell?
settings.answer: Ingredients come first: no parabens or sulfates, and the full formula is always listed. Then we use the product ourselves for a few weeks. If we would not buy it again, it does not go in the store.

settings.question: Are the products safe for children and pets?
settings.answer: Our eco cleaning products are made to be safe around children and pets, and the kids range is marked separately. Each product page lists who it is for — and if in doubt, write to us before you order.

settings.question: How fast do you deliver?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 2–4 days. Delivery is free on orders over $50.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Yes — unopened products can be returned within 14 days, free of charge. Write to us and we will arrange the pickup.
